metadata.description: The agent-workflow plugin: working-rule skills for a test-first, independently reviewed development loop.

plugins.name: agent-workflow
plugins.description: A lightweight, agent-agnostic development loop: probe, test first, mutation-check, independent headless review, conventional and attribution-free commits.

plugins.name: change-record
plugins.description: One change record per change, a tier by risk instead of file count, and CI checks for evidence: red-check (changed tests fail on the base) and record-check (the record exists and tier 2 is approved before code).
